# SparkNote
中文 | English

> **Compatibility:** plugin `0.1.3` requires **DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` · Web**.
>
> `package.json` pins `en
gines.dsh` to this exact version. Other DSH versions, including newer releases, and Desktop installa
tion have not been verified.
## Summary
Highlight replies while reading, then collect the whole reply with all its marks. Highlights save au
tomatically before collection. The collection keeps a copy of the reply so it remains readable after
its source session is deleted. This optional bundle adds a collection to your Web profile.
## Screenshots

Highlight as you read: select text and choose a color before collecting.
Browse saved replies by conversation name and reply opening.
Open a collection to read the saved user question, reply, and colored highlights together.
## Use this package
Install SparkNote `0.1.3` through the Plugins page or run this command for your Web profile, then re
ote `0.1.3` through the Plugins page or run this command for your Web profile, then restart DSH Web:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Select text in a completed reply and choose yellow, green, blue, or pink. Click an existing highligh
t to change or remove it. The five-point star below the reply collects its full Markdown, existing h
ighlights, and the corresponding user question by default. The default title combines the conversati
on name with the opening of the reply; you can rename it afterward. Open Collection in the sidebar t
o search reply text, saved questions, and highlights, rename a collection, read, edit highlights, or
open the source conversation. Saved replies show colored highlights directly on their original text
, including selections across Markdown blocks. The Manage highlights section stays collapsed until y
ou open it to browse quotes or use its controls. Removing a collection keeps its highlight draft.
Changes show as saved only after the Host commits them. A failed operation keeps existing data and o
ffers Retry. Data is stored under the Harness home using the profile's configured storage provider.
Unloading the bundle removes its UI without deleting its data.
For plugin development, run `pnpm install`, `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm run pack:bu
ndle` in this directory. The bundle has its own lockfile and does not modify the Harness workspace d
rectory. The bundle has its own lockfile and does not modify the Harness workspace dependency graph.
This directory is an independent Git repository. Run plugin Git commands here and Harness Git comman
ds in the DSH checkout. To prepare a keyless recorded-session check, run `pnpm run prepare:smoke --d
sh-root D:/00-code/DSH`; omission of `--dsh-root` uses the sibling `DSH` directory. The script print
s isolated test paths and does not start a server.
## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals
The profile patch mounts one Host plugin and its browser contribution. The Host validates owner-only
RPC requests and serializes mutations to versioned storage records. The browser uses additive Chat,
sidebar, main-panel, and overlay slots. A release-specific DOM adapter maps text selections to comp
leted Chat nodes and paints CSS Custom Highlights without modifying React-owned content. Exact quote
s and surrounding text locate highlights after layout changes, with separator-newline differences ma
pped back to the rendered text; ambiguous matches remain unpainted and their saved quotes remain ava
ck to the rendered text; ambiguous matches remain unpainted and their saved quotes remain available.
## Model Experience
This bundle contributes no model tools or prompt content. Collections and annotations are private re
ading data and do not enter the model context.
## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
The user question must be loaded in the current Chat history before you can collect its reply. Quest
ion attachments are not copied. Older collections without a saved question remain readable and show
a notice. Only completed text replies with a standard action row are supported. Streaming replies, r
easoning, images, freehand drawing, and cross-message selections are excluded. Text highlighting nee
ds a current browser with CSS Custom Highlight support. The DOM adapter is pinned to the declared DS
H version; Desktop installation is unverified. Other browser windows refresh their collection when f
ocused; live multi-window updates and collection export are not included. Opening the source returns
to its conversation, without paging to the exact historical message.
## Planned Features
The following features are planned and are not available in the current release:

- Tags for organizing saved replies.
- Category filtering.
- Statistics by category.
- Usage reports

.
- Notes on saved content and sharing.
- Integration with third-party note-taking tools.
## Community and contribution
This is an independently maintained community plugin. The DSH contribution guide asks plugin authors
to add the `dsh-plugin` GitHub repository topic so others can discover their work. Report plugin bu
gs and suggest improvements in this repository's Issues.
## Dev Note
Version `0.1.3` uses `sparknote` for its internal plugin ID and storage domain. Collections saved by
`v0.1.2` or earlier local builds are not migrated and do not appear in this version.
